name: AEX worker capability report schema

capability.plugin_id: stable local id from allowlist or catalog

params.label: display label
params.kind: float | int | bool | choice | color | point | path | unknown

last_result.status: ok | allowlist_denied | unsupported_selector | unsupported_suite | timeout | plugin_exception | worker_crash | internal_error

notes: This schema is shared by aex-image-probe, future AviUtlas external effect integration, and future OFX facade.
Unsupported features must be reported instead of faked.
Crash and timeout history must not include binary payloads or private image contents.
